A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''noble''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was particularly famous during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The nobleman's [[Unidentified Alderaanian nobleman's son|son]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] and the [[Unidentified Alderaanian nobleman's alleged killer|suspected killer]] was arrested and incarcerated. However, an individual discovered a journal that proved the suspect to be innocent, and the nobleman was moved to tears by the return of his son's journal, prompting him to ensure that the wrongfully-accused man was freed.<ref name="Lost Memories" />
